title: CacheRoute: Planned Prefix-Affinity Routing for Large-Scale LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2608.19677v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prefix caching avoids prefill only when a repeated request returns to a server that still holds the prefix KV. Cache-blind balancing disperses that reuse; fixed affinity preserves it but can overload a server. CacheRoute resolves this tradeoff with a periodic routing plan. It admits high-rate keys to a stable warm set and places their assignments by expected load. Hot keys may use more than one destination, although every key in our primary semi-synthetic aggregate uses exactly one. On Llama-3.3-70B in fp8 across 60 H100 GPUs, CacheRoute sustains 176+/-11 QPS at a 3.5-s p99 SLO, 2.3x the strongest of five baselines. Served KV-cache hit rate rises from 64.1+/-1.3% under cache-blind balancing to 93.2+/-0.5%. A second semi-synthetic aggregate and controlled 8B and burst experiments separate the effects of affinity and placement. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19677v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：前缀缓存仅在重复请求返回到仍持有前缀KV的服务器时避免预填充。缓存盲平衡会分散这种重用；固定亲和性保留它但可能使服务器过载。CacheRoute通过周期性路由计划解决了这一权衡。它将高频率键分配到稳定的热集，并根据预期负载放置其分配。热键可能使用多个目的地，尽管我们主要半合成聚合中的每个键恰好使用一个。在60个H100 GPU上使用Llama-3.3-70B（fp8格式），CacheRoute在3.5秒p99 SLO下维持176±11 QPS，是五个基线中最强者的2.3倍。服务KV缓存命中率从缓存盲平衡下的64.1±1.3%提升至93.2±0.5%。第二个半合成聚合以及受控的8B和突发实验分离了亲和性和放置的影响。两个32B工作负载提供了反例：当亲和性恢复的KV工作太少时，其残余负载倾斜......
tldr: CacheRoute通过周期性路由计划结合前缀亲和性与负载均衡，显著提升大规模LLM服务的缓存命中率和吞吐量，同时保持SLO。
en_tdlr: CacheRoute combines prefix affinity with load balancing via periodic routing plans, significantly improving cache hit rates and throughput for large-scale LLM serving while maintaining SLOs.
